C0711.title: AI-Generated Military Disinformation Cases Publicly Named
C0711.summary: During a 2026 special campaign to govern the online military-related ecosystem, authorities reported multiple cases involving the use of AI to create and disseminate false military information. Violations included AI-fabricated military stories, vulgar derivative content, and the mockery of military personnel images.
